summary: Verified incoming-call tracking end-to-end. Backend: /api/dashboard/stats returns incoming_calls:{count,total_time_seconds} + verified_talk_time_seconds; /api/call-logs/sync creates verified_call_logs with call_type='incoming', updates daily_sessions.verified_incoming_calls / verified_incoming_time_seconds / verified_talk_time_seconds, and reflects in dashboard. Frontend: Telecaller Dashboard 'Today's Activity' section shows Outgoing, Incoming, Total Talk (outgoing + incoming), Idle Time — all values render correctly from backend.
critical_code_review_comments: calls.py sync endpoint recomputes verified_talk_time by re-fetching ALL today's verified logs on every sync (O(N) each call). For heavy sync loads consider an incremental $inc, or an aggregation $group instead of Python sum.

Business rule assumed: incoming calls with duration_seconds<=0 are not counted (verified). This is only implemented in the sync route; the /reports/verified-call-stats route uses duration_seconds>0 for connected_count but count includes all - subtle inconsistency between 'incoming count' definitions across endpoints (dashboard: connected only; verified-call-stats: total including missed-like 0-duration).

Dashboard.js 'Total Talk' sums activityStats.total_call_seconds + stats.incoming_calls.total_time_seconds. activityStats.total_call_seconds represents call-session time (manual outgoing) not verified outgoing sync time; if outgoing calls come only from device sync (mobile), Total Talk may under-report outgoing. Consider using stats.verified_talk_time_seconds which already includes both.
